fields.label: Allowed Domains (one per line)
fields.description: Limit external redirects to these hosts. Leave blank to allow any http(s).

fields.label: Default Rate Limit / Minute
fields.description: Resolver uses this only if a token has no per-minute limit.

fields.label: Require Login to Resolve
fields.description: If enabled, /qr?token=... requires a signed-in user.

fields.label: Store QR Images as Private
fields.description: When enabled, saved PNGs are private files. Prints embed a data-URI, not a URL.

fields.label: Role-Based Redirects
fields.description: Configure role-based redirects for Token-based QR codes. Each row maps a Role + DocType to a redirect destination.

fields.options:
Note: Role-based redirects only work for Token link types. Direct links bypass this feature.

When a logged-in user scans a Token QR, they will be redirected based on their roles. If a user has multiple matching roles, they'll see a choice page to select their destination. Guest users always get the default redirect.
